title: Structured/field-level write path so editors can save without round-tripping redacted secrets
description: Cross-cutting E5 issue: GET /api/file returns REDACTED content (secrets → [REDACTED:*] to keep them off the wire, correct per SPEC §3). Proper fix options: (a) a structured/field-level write API (PATCH a specific JSON key/frontmatter field, server merges into the real on-disk file so untouched secret fields are preserved), or (b) an authenticated per-field reveal + re-save, or (c) server-side merge that re-injects on-disk secret values into the saved content by span. Design + implement so editors can edit secret-bearing configs safely. Until then editors are read-only on redacted files. Related [[fix-patch-carries-content]].

Proper fix: collect .gitignore in the scanner (like np8.12/np8.13 additive KNOWN_FILES) so the analyzer sees existing content and emits a replace-file fix that APPENDS the ignore line (preserving existing content). src/core work. Until then the 409 guard prevents data loss but the .gitignore fix no-ops on existing files.
